hypothesis: An 8-thread CTA may alter scheduling for the one-thread-per-target kernel, but it also activates fewer lanes per warp and launches more CTAs than the previously measured 12-thread configuration. Measuring this single geometry change will show whether smaller CTAs help or hurt; more CTAs do not guarantee a gain.
notes: Only launch geometry changes; the kernel, force equations, traversal, and memory strategy remain unchanged. The baseline measured 0.001852641 s, while the valid 12-thread experiment measured 0.001797794 s. Those observations motivate this test but do not establish its outcome. Run the full supported-size correctness checks before comparing official timings; no measurement or validation is claimed here.
